standard_prerequisites.name: Finite Markov chains, rooted forests, harmonic extension matrices and adjugates
standard_prerequisites.statement: Native irreducibility/support conditions for walk laws and full nonsingular-base hypothesis for the real-matrix identity retained, along with growth-order definitions, forest/root-block indicators and auxiliary cofactor proofs.
standard_prerequisites.use: Entire original mathematical body, supplemental algebraic examples, figures and bibliography preserved. The general-chain Aldous-Broder theorem is credited to its existing source and used as context, not counted as a new separate theorem.

core_obligations: Proves a one-vertex transfer identity using rank-one determinant and block expansions, folds harmonic extension columns as the forest base grows and iterates the transfer over all growth orders to obtain a cofactor depending only on root blocks.
difficulty_reason: Proves a one-vertex transfer identity using rank-one determinant and block expansions, folds harmonic extension columns as the forest base grows and iterates the transfer over all growth orders to obtain a cofactor depending only on root blocks.

dedup.scope: Focused source/order-mass/stopped-covering-walk/Aldous-Broder metadata search across all three indexes found no related primary. The cited general-chain Aldous-Broder theorem, conditional order corollaries, real aggregation and numerical illustrations are not separate counts.
